teaching_service_classification.proposal: Do not use 412 merely because the payees may be contractors: teaching is not consulting or accounting. A dedicated Contractor teaching costs account with Direct Costs type is the most faithful presentation, but creating or renaming an account requires founder approval. If no chart change is approved, use 429 as the least false broad existing fallback with exact teaching-service descriptions and year-end presentation review. Do not use 310 unless the founder explicitly approves broadening or renaming its goods-only semantics. Do not use Wages and Salaries without employment/payroll facts.
